context:
Goal: settle Card in Hand's open choices, so Duo can plan the build.
Problem: the last version invented an "end of mail day". The app has no such thing, and I'm sorry for that. The real question: in Card in Hand, a card that could belong to two envelopes waits on a Suspense line until it's decided. What happens to it if you close Card in Hand first?
Based on: decision duo-card-in-hand, your 12:25 pick f with the Suspense line (ruling).
Meanwhile: Duo plans the build and starts nothing until you answer.
holds: Duo's build plan for Card in Hand waits on this.

options.gain: Nothing moves without you; no new path.
options.how: Held cards wait there until you decide them, however long that takes.
options.label: They stay on the Suspense line
options.lose: The line can carry cards from an older pile.

options.gain: Card in Hand starts clean every time.
options.how: When you close Card in Hand, held cards become one envelope on the Orphaned tab.
options.label: They move to Orphaned
options.lose: A new way into Orphaned, and you decide those cards there instead.

ref: Duo design round 2, draft PR #144 (Card in Hand screens)
title: Card in Hand: what happens to held cards when you close it?
why: Least to build, and no card changes place on its own.
